strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause treatment from prior transform tuning: restore authored map ownership, collision/navigation exclusion, and authoritative lifecycle reset in the spatial task; implement real icon-led choice bindings and state-bound guidance persistence in the HUD/run task.
